title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
abstract: arXiv:2610.26722v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision

translated_title: 重复条件下的复制：从前缀匹配到位置哈希
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）几乎能够完美复制随机文本，但在处理长段重复字符时却常常出现过度复制或截断的问题。在重复字符串中，匹配局部内容不再能可靠地判断复制应从何处继续或何时停止。然而，我们证明了一个具有 $O(\log\log N)$ 位精度和 $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ 宽度的两层 Transformer 能够复制直到设计上限 $N$ 的任意字符串，并在任意重复情况下正确终止。我们采用具有小素数周期的 RoPE 风格的注意力值与输出旋转（VO-旋转），以对这些素数取模的方式编码到分隔符锚点的距离。根据中国剩余定理，这些周期性编码共同区分了所有所需的距离，使得单一检索规则即可选择下一个源 token 或结束标记。相比之下，我们证明了在顺序有限精度下复制的一个与宽度无关的不可能性结果。
tldr: 本文提出利用小素数周期的VO旋转位置编码并结合中国剩余定理，证明了两层Transformer能在任意重复字符串下实现精确复制并正确终止，同时给出了顺序有限精度下复制的不可能性证明。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a two-layer transformer with VO-rotations using small prime periods and the Chinese Remainder Theorem can copy arbitrary strings and terminate correctly under repetition, while also establishing a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite precision.
